server_id.description: The server_id from PreviewStart or PreviewList

lines.description: How many of the last matching lines to return (default 200)

level.description: error keeps only lines that look like errors (default all)

search.description: Only lines containing this text, ignoring case

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
